title: Review sequential awaits inside loops
why: Awaiting each iteration serializes independent work and can make total latency grow with the item count.
suggestion: Use Promise.all with an explicit concurrency limit when iterations are independent; keep sequential awaits when ordering or backpressure is required.
limitations: Only lines beginning with await inside braced loops are reported.
Data dependencies, rate limits, ordering requirements, and deliberate sequential backpressure are not inferred.
